# Fixtures

Nothing in this directory is checked in as static data. Both files referenced from [`docs/TESTING.md`](../../docs/TESTING.md) are generated by running the harnesses, not pre-existing inputs:

| File | Produced by | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `liquidations.jsonl` | A one-time historical export step (pull real past liquidation events for Kamino, Save, and MarginFi from on-chain history) that must be run before `cargo run --bin replay` has anything to replay against | One JSON record per historical liquidation event |
| `cu_table.csv` | `cargo run --bin cu-profile` | Per-route measured CU consumption; output artifact, not an input |

Populate `liquidations.jsonl` before running the replay harness described in [`docs/RUNBOOK.md#first-action`](../../docs/RUNBOOK.md#first-action) — that step is the first thing to build and the first thing to validate, and it has no data to validate against until this file exists.
